function_specs.name: _SemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Refine abs_semaphore_create from LastSeen(before), returning -5 or an ID in [0,128), preserving OutsideCritical and the continuation.

function_specs.name: KSemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Provide exactly the same semaphore-creation refinement and OutsideCritical postcondition by calling _SemaphoreCreate.
